lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Organized grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately seven vertical columns and four horizontal rows on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity that align with the centroids of the high-luminance blobs, creating a rectangular grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges visible along the upper half of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark, elongated shapes attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
